extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of classic literature, especially Rabelais/Gargantua enthusiasts
extracted.subtask_description: Close-reading of an English translation excerpt from Rabelais' Gargantua and Pantagruel (chapters on marriage, cuckoldry, and the nature of women), focusing on its satirical and comic discourse. The page is a literary text rather than a guideline or evaluation rubric.
